title: Illustration tools
description: A complete brand identity for Ilunstuck, a creative coaching and productivity platform helping professionals break through creative blocks. The visual identity needed to balance the seriousness of professional development with the energy of creative liberation.
challenge: Ilunstuck sits between two worlds: the structured world of professional coaching and the expressive world of creative work. Most competitors chose one or the other — Ilunstuck needed an identity that lived confidently in both.
solution: Built an identity around controlled tension: structured geometric forms that break open, revealing texture and color. The typographic system uses a contrast between rigid grid alignment and deliberate rule-breaking moments — a visual metaphor for the product itself.
result: The brand launched to strong community reception, with founder-led social posts featuring the identity driving over 200k organic impressions in the first week. The design has been widely shared within Chilean design and startup communities.
